query: Create a bar chart to compare the composite deprivation scores (Column B) across different Unitary Authorities (Column A) in the South East region.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(df['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)'], df['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1'])
plt.title('Composite Deprivation Scores by Unitary Authority')
plt.xlabel('Unitary Authority')
plt.ylabel('Composite Deprivation Score')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)', 'y_fields': ['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1'], 'chart_type': 'barChart'}
plt.show()

query: Create a pie chart to show the proportion of the total aggregate deprivation measure (Column J) for the top 5 most deprived Unitary Authorities.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
top_5 = df.nsmallest(5, 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1')
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))
plt.pie(top_5['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).9'], labels=top_5['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)'], autopct='%1.1f%%')
plt.title('Proportion of Total Aggregate Deprivation Measure for Top 5 Most Deprived U.A.s')
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': '', 'y_fields': ['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).9'], 'chart_type': 'pieChart'}
plt.show()

Rank 1 = most deprived).8'], bottom=df['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).2'] + df['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b.
